source_corrections.finding: the prior latch used Q as FAULT_KILL and CLR_N as POR, so brownout selected the permissive output and PRE_N/CLR_N could enter the prohibited both-low state
source_corrections.correction: Q is RUN_PERMIT, Q_N is FAULT_KILL, PRE_N is tied high and CLR_N is POR_N AND FAULT_ASSERT_N
source_corrections.functional_effect: brownout and every fault now force the non-permissive state without an illegal asynchronous-input combination

source_corrections.finding: the text claimed about 57.6 ms although the physical TPS3808 CT contact was open
source_corrections.correction: the contract now uses the exact 12-to-28-ms CT-open interval and a separate RC/Schmitt re-arm edge
source_corrections.functional_effect: the documented timing now matches the real populated contacts

rearm_calculation.failure_direction: if effective capacitance falls below the analytical floor, the safe failure is missed startup/re-arm while clear is active; it cannot assert RUN_PERMIT through CLR_N

sequences.result: clear remains asserted during POR; an early clock is ignored; no automatic restart; operator cycles KILL→RUN

sequences.initial: AON valid; switch KILL; every fault healthy
sequences.result: delayed Schmitt edge clocks D=1 after POR; RUN_PERMIT rises

sequences.event: switch KILL or RUN conductor opens
sequences.result: FAULT_ASSERT_N low asynchronously clears RUN_PERMIT; TX gates fall safe; C5/RP reset; pack shutdown requested

sequences.event: watchdog, thermal, evidence or controller fault
sequences.result: asynchronous clear latches FAULT_KILL; recovering fault cannot restart while switch remains RUN

sequences.event: software reset, USB attach or fault source recovers
sequences.result: no clock edge; permit remains low

sequences.event: operator holds KILL at least 0.5 s, then selects RUN after cause is safe
sequences.result: RC is discharged below the worst negative threshold, then one clean delayed re-arm edge is possible
application gets a bounded 3-s storage/UI grace; RF lease is revoked first; deadline expiry becomes hard FAULT_KILL

firmware_contract.hard_fault: no firmware grace; asynchronous hardware kill wins immediately
